audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN 5.5/10 fits the 51.72% over 6757 games, but the page never named the two ranges that actually decide the lane: Inner Flame 950 versus your Q 900, and Focused Resolve's 675 tether range.
audit.why: She out-ranges your only ranged spell by 50 units, and everything she does to you inside 675 sets up the root. Outside 675 she has only Inner Flame.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early, phases[0].why and tradeGood now key off 675/900/950 instead of an unsourced '60%'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Skill,Skill,Skill,Skill,Zed,Skill,Skill while the content layer and the packet both read Karma,Karma,Skill,Skill,Zed,Zed,Zed. Rows 0,1,5,6 disagreed across the two layers.
audit.why: Karma owns levels 1-2 (Mantra needs no skill point, so empowered Inner Flame is live immediately and out-ranges you). Zed owns first item and 2+ items (lethality one-combos a Karma whose only escape is Inspire's move speed).
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and phases[1].side Skill->Karma; phases[5].side and phases[6].side Skill->Zed, proposed as one atomic group. win[0..6] already matched the packet so no no-op content edits were added. phases[0].why and phases[1].why rewritten in the same proposal to say Karma wins those rows; phases[5].why/[6].why already described Zed winning.
sources: champ-data/_kits/karma.json (R: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point')

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated. Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if it is not broken, and Living Shadow's swap is the tool that breaks it. Gathering Fire (passive) shortening Mantra every time her damage hits you was also absent.
audit.why: Riot W text: 'Karma creates a tether ... If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted'. Riot passive text: 'Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.' Living Shadow is 650 range on a 20/19/18/17/16s cooldown; the swap is the distance break.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[2].d, loading and dosFull[0].t now state the tether break and the Mantra refund with real numbers (12s flat W, 40/38/36/34 Mantra, 20s Living Shadow).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and restated the field title back at the reader.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s at every rank — unusually, it does not scale, so the window never widens. Mantra is 40/38/36/34s but Gathering Fire pulls it forward whenever her damage lands on you.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with both numbers and what each permits.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere on the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal. Riot W text: Mantra Bonus 'healing herself and extending the root duration' — the empowered tether is a heal on a 12s spell.
audit.corrected: Named Executioner's Calling in spikes[2].text, tied to the Mantra-W heal. Kept it out of report[8].t to stay inside the report-rewrite cap.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] described a 'level-3 RQ burst' inside the Level 2 row.
audit.why: Mantra requires no skill point and is available from level 1, so the empowered Inner Flame is online at 2, not 3.
